title: AudioChunk
description: A single chunk of call audio crossing the media boundary. Phase 1 documents the shape only; no real audio is streamed yet.

call_id.description: Call this audio belongs to (correlation ID).

sequence.description: Monotonic chunk index within the call.

codec.description: Audio encoding. Phase 1 baseline is 16-bit signed little-endian PCM.

sample_rate.description: Samples per second. AudioSocket baseline is 8000.

data.description: Base64-encoded PCM payload. Tests MUST NOT embed real audio.
